sv.title: Borgs varning: Därför borde C göra upp med SD
sv.summary: En ny alliansregering behöver göra upp med SD. Det menar tidigare finansministern Anders Borg (M) – som menar att Centern måste budgetsamarbeta med Åkessons parti. ”Det bör vara ett villkor”, skriver han på Facebook.

en.title: Borg's warning: This is why the C should come to terms with the SD
en.summary: A new Alliance government needs to come to terms with the SD. That is the view of former finance minister Anders Borg (M) – who argues that the Centre Party must cooperate on the budget with Åkesson's party. "It should be a condition", he writes on Facebook.
